tagline: Leading specialty insurance and reinsurance company with decentralized operations across 60 businesses
hero_kpi_rationale: Key insurance sector metric reflecting growth in insurance and reinsurance operations with $12.7B in net premiums written in 2025, up 5.5% year-on-year

kpis.name: Net premiums written
kpis.explanation: Net premiums written by the company across all its operations
kpis.description: Net premiums written by the consolidated insurance company for the Insurance and Reinsurance segments

kpis.name: Net premiums written - Insurance Segment
kpis.explanation: Net premiums written by the company for the insurance segment
kpis.description: Net premiums written by the company for the insurance segment, representing 88% of total activity
kpis.signal: Growth in net premiums written for the insurance segment (88% of total)

kpis.name: Net premiums written - Reinsurance Segment
kpis.explanation: Net premiums written by the company for the monoline excess reinsurance segment
kpis.description: Net premiums written by the company for the Monoline Excess Reinsurance segment, representing 12% of total activity
kpis.signal: Growth in net premiums written for the reinsurance segment (12% of total)

kpis.name: Consolidated GAAP combined ratio
kpis.explanation: Sum of loss ratio and expense ratio; below 100 indicates underwriting profit.
kpis.description: The consolidated combined ratio was 90.7% in 2025 compared to 90.3% in 2024, reflecting an increase in the loss ratio (+0.6 pt) partially offset by an improvement in the expense ratio (-0.2 pt). Underwriting profitability remains strong.

kpis.name: Net investment income
kpis.explanation: Income generated by the invested asset portfolio net of management fees, excluding realized gains/losses.
kpis.description: Net investment income increased by 7% to $1,429M in 2025, primarily driven by a larger bond portfolio (+$47M) and recovery in private investments (+$39M). The average annualized yield remains stable at 4.5%.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to common shareholders divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares.
kpis.description: Diluted EPS reached $4.45 in 2025 versus $4.36 in 2024, supported by higher net income (+$23M) and a reduction in shares outstanding (-3.4M shares via buybacks). Organic growth and capital discipline combine favorably.

kpis.name: Consolidated gross premiums written
kpis.explanation: Total gross premiums underwritten before reinsurance cessions, reflecting total business volume.
kpis.description: Gross premiums written increased by 6% to $15,105M in 2025, driven by insurance (+$803M) and reinsurance (+$91M). Average renewal rate increases were 6.7% with an 81% retention rate.

kpis.name: Consolidated loss ratio
kpis.explanation: Claims and claims expenses divided by net earned premiums; measures technical quality of underwriting.
kpis.description: The consolidated loss ratio was 62.4% in 2025 versus 61.8% in 2024. Net catastrophe losses reached $336M (vs $298M in 2024), primarily due to California wildfires. Excluding catastrophes and reserve development, the underlying ratio increased by 0.6 pt to 59.8%.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.09 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.7B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 39.4% in the latest year.

risks.title: Cyclical fluctuations in the insurance sector
risks.score_rationale: The company's results are subject to significant fluctuations due to cyclical changes in the insurance and reinsurance markets. Supply and demand factors directly impact operational profitability.

risks.title: Natural catastrophes and extreme events
risks.score_rationale: Natural catastrophes and extreme events can have a significant impact on the company's results. Catastrophe losses are inherently unpredictable and potentially substantial for insurers.

risks.title: Uncertainty of ultimate claims costs
risks.score_rationale: Premium rates are set before actual claims costs are known. Uncertainty in ultimate costs arises from numerous external factors including economic and social inflation, judicial decisions, and regulatory changes.

risks.title: Climate change and increasing climate risks
risks.score_rationale: Climate change may increase the frequency and severity of natural catastrophes, directly impacting the company's results through larger and more frequent claims.

risks.title: Claims reserves risk
risks.score_rationale: Claims reserves are based on complex and subjective estimates using actuarial data. Reserve deficiencies or redundancies can significantly impact future results when estimates are revised.

risks.title: Terrorism and malicious acts risk
risks.score_rationale: Acts of terrorism certified by the U.S. Secretary of the Treasury can generate significant losses. Coverage for these risks is subject to legal and regulatory limitations.

risks.title: Increased competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the commercial insurance sector may create downward pricing pressure, affecting profitability even with growth in written premium volumes.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in WRB's 10-K/20-F filing.
